title: Walking in Others’ Shoes: How Perspective-Taking Guides Large Language Models in Reducing Toxicity and Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating global bias through sentence-level sentiment analysis (using VADER to measure Mean Sentiments, Deviation of Sentiments, and Average Group Fairness) and regard scores (Average Regards Difference using a trained classifier) on open-ended text generations prompted by the BOLD dataset for male and female subgroups.
